description: This file implements a Bootstrap v2.0.4 plugin for collapsible UI components, defining the Collapse class with methods for showing, hiding, toggling, and resetting collapsible elements, along with jQuery plugin registration and data-API event handling.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: A class managing the collapse behavior of UI elements, including show, hide, toggle, reset, and transition handling.

methods.name: Collapse
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collapse component with element and options.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Returns the dimension ('width' or 'height') based on the element's classes.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the collapsible element, handling active siblings and transition.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the collapsible element, handling transition.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the element's size and classes.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Handles the transition animation for show/hide.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between show and hide states.
